validated_mechanisms: formal-domain presence blocks the first-domain mutation workflow
exactly one hosting route may execute and the inactive route must be coherently not_required
production-origin preflight rejects stale static origins and missing representative routes
Vercel DNS values are treated as live project data rather than hardcoded constants
launch reports reject execution without exact authorization and secret-like fields
domain_ready and DNSSEC claims require mode-specific provider and public evidence
public verification requires distinct public resolver consensus and successful DNSSEC validation when requested
HTTPS verification rejects downgrade redirects and malformed observations without crashing
optional SaaS SEO checks allow absence but still reject a wrong canonical
AGENTS.md writeback is post-domain-ready, project-root-only, idempotent, and conflict/symlink safe
evidence_boundary: Recorded fixtures and deterministic unit tests validate contract behavior only. Provider-backed comparison and human blind review remain missing evidence.
